title: LARecomp dependency kits
description: Pinned third-party files. The URL is an archive when zip_sha256 is present and a base URL for individual files otherwise. Paths are relative to the kit root, and a missing group condition means the group can be used on any host.

min_launcher.description: optional: the oldest LAUNCHER PROGRAM (the app the player runs; its own version is <major>.<days since 2026-01-01>.<minute of day>, like 1.332.480) that can set up and run this game version. A launcher whose version is lower must not build or update to this game version: it shows a 'this game version needs a newer launcher' screen and keeps the install it has. min_reader is the contract-format gate; this is the program gate (new setup actions, new launcher features the game relies on). Absent means no requirement; a launcher that cannot parse the value ignores it. The single source is min_launcher of launcher-recipe.json at the game repo root; the other contract files take the value from it.
